title: Keyboard effects implementation checklist
intent: Implementation checklist and evidence. All 180 public effect IDs have engine renderers; renderer implementation is distinct from exact algorithm acceptance, UI exposure, host-source setup, visual review, and physical keyboard validation.

baseline.note: Snapshot for planning; another Codex is actively changing the app. Re-read affected files before implementation.

available: Layout-derived geometry, neighbors, rows, columns, and physical key-code mapping.
extend: Graph routing, hulls, reusable spatial interpolation where required.

available: Typed numeric/select controls, normalization, stable per-effect parameter definitions.
extend: Register expansion controls and verify parameter discovery for new IDs.

available: Bounded press history, held/released key semantics, per-effect controls, releaseAll().
extend: Reusable bounded activity/transition aggregates and simulation inputs.

available: Four audio render styles, waveform input support, screen sampling, per-key color helpers.
composeLayers() supports animation sources, opacity, zones, and normal/add/screen/multiply blending.
SystemSample and renderActivity() provide CPU/memory rendering primitives.
extend: Mixed source types, spatial masks, persistent scene state, event overlays, and transitions.
Reuse system telemetry inputs where wired; verify each real host source rather than assuming it exists.

available: Level/bass/mid/treble, 20-bin spectrum summaries, centroid, and engine-owned audio state.
extend: Onset features, separate stereo channels, pitch-class confidence, tempo/beat-phase analysis.

available: Bridge contract, frame-rate limits, serialized writes and lifecycle.
extend: Retain this contract; no protocol changes are required by effect formulas.

available: Family/variation metadata and fallback discovery for animation registry entries.
extend: Coordinate future family metadata and capability/availability display with the UI owner.

constraints: Do not modify the active UI implementation while using this checklist without coordinating its owner. Engine additions should be isolated under the proposed expansion area and integrated with minimal current-source changes.
Reuse current controls, audio primitives, geometry, layers, and system renderers. The earlier ideas catalog predates some of these additions; this checklist records the newer baseline.

Target paths, parameter ranges, and algorithm choices are concrete starting specifications, not existing APIs or implemented files. Adjust them with evidence during implementation and keep stable IDs.
A live integration is done only when both renderer and real source work. A sample event, sample audio, or virtual layout is never evidence of live-source or physical-device support.

statusModel.inProgress: Some implementation or acceptance checks completed.
statusModel.done: All implementation and acceptance checks completed and evidence recorded. Browser checkmarks are local planning state, not automatically verified repository state.

definitionOfDone.text: All output IDs belong to the supplied layout; channels are finite integers in 0..255.
One-key, one-row, split/gapped, F75, and larger layouts have documented meaningful rendering or an explicit availability/fallback policy.
Seed/time/input replay is deterministic; mutable state is isolated per engine; repeat rendering cannot duplicate input impulses.
Each advertised control changes the documented behavior; defaults, limits, unknown keys, and malformed values normalize correctly.
Stop/reset/restart/pause/resume/lost-input behavior is defined; particles, histories, graphs, and queues stay within declared bounds.
Headless fixture coverage and a readable virtual-keyboard preview verify behavior before a real-device smoke test.
Registration, metadata, persistence, and counts match the entry kind; variants/scenes/integrations are not mislabeled as new base algorithms.
